patron_of.pick: {label} is the patron saint of which place?
patron_of.match: Match each saint to the place they watch over.
patron_of.odd: Three of these saints are patrons of {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Paul the Apostle
rows.description: Early Christian apostle and missionary (c. AD 5 – c. 64/65)
rows.hook: wrote many New Testament letters and spread Christianity across the ancient Mediterranean

rows.label: Saint Peter
rows.description: apostle of Jesus Christ
rows.hook: was a fisherman who became a leading disciple of Jesus and is said to hold the keys to heaven

rows.label: Michael
rows.description: archangel in Jewish, Christian, and Islamic teachings
rows.hook: is the warrior archangel who leads heaven's armies against evil

rows.label: Francis of Assisi
rows.description: Italian Catholic saint, friar, deacon and preacher and founder of the Franciscan Order (1181/2–1226)
rows.hook: gave up a wealthy life to found an order of friars and is linked with animals and nature

rows.label: Thomas Aquinas
rows.description: Italian Dominican friar, philosopher, Catholic priest, and Doctor of the Church (1225–1274)
rows.hook: wrote the Summa Theologica, blending Aristotle's ideas with Catholic theology

rows.label: John the Baptist
rows.description: 1st-century Jewish itinerant preacher (Bible)
rows.hook: preached in the wilderness and baptized Jesus in the Jordan River

rows.label: Saint George
rows.description: Christian saint and martyr (died 303)
rows.hook: was a Roman soldier and martyr, famous in legend for slaying a dragon

rows.label: Our Lady of Guadalupe
rows.description: title of the Virgin Mary as she appeared to an Indigenous man in Mexico in December 1531
rows.hook: is a title of the Virgin Mary tied to a miraculous image said to appear on a cloak

rows.label: Jerome
rows.description: 4th and 5th-century Catholic and Eastern Orthodox saint and Doctor of the Church

rows.label: Saint Nicholas
rows.description: 4th-century Christian bishop and saint
rows.hook: was a generous bishop who loved children and is the root of the Santa Claus legend

rows.label: Saint Joseph
rows.description: Christian saint; husband of Mary and father of Jesus
rows.hook: was a carpenter from Nazareth who raised Jesus as his legal son

rows.label: Matthew the Apostle
rows.description: Christian evangelist and apostle (10-74)
rows.hook: was a tax collector who became a disciple and is credited with a gospel including the Sermon on the Mount

rows.label: Teresa of Ávila
rows.description: Roman Catholic saint (1515-1582)

rows.label: Saint Christopher
rows.description: saint in the Catholic and Orthodox church
rows.hook: is the legendary giant said to have carried the child Christ across a river

rows.label: Saint Sebastian
rows.description: Christian saint and martyr (256–288)

rows.label: Anthony of Padua
rows.description: Franciscan saint, Doctor of the Church (1195–1231)

rows.label: Thomas the Apostle
rows.description: one of the Twelve Apostles in the New Testament

rows.label: Benedict of Nursia
rows.description: founder of Christian monasticism, founder of the Benedictine order (480–547)

rows.label: Catherine of Siena
rows.description: Italian Dominican saint (1347-1380)

rows.label: Bartholomew the Apostle
rows.description: Christian apostle and martyr

rows.label: Januarius
rows.description: Bishop of Naples (232-305)

rows.label: Saint Lucy
rows.description: saint from Italy

rows.label: Andrew the Apostle
rows.description: religious figure of the Christian faith

rows.label: Francis Xavier
rows.description: Spanish Catholic saint and missionary (1506–1552)

rows.label: Luke the Evangelist
rows.description: one of the four evangelists
rows.hook: is credited with writing a gospel and the Book of Acts, and is traditionally called a physician

rows.label: Catherine of Alexandria
rows.description: Egyptian missionary, saint depicted with a wheel

rows.label: Mark the Evangelist
rows.description: credited author of the Gospel of Mark and Christian saint; traditionally identified with John Mark (20-68)
rows.hook: is traditionally credited with writing the shortest of the four gospels

rows.label: Justin Martyr
rows.description: 2nd century CE Christian apologist and martyr

rows.label: Saint Anne
rows.description: mother of Virgin Mary in Christian and Islamic traditions; unnamed in the New Testament or Quran
rows.hook: is traditionally named as the mother of the Virgin Mary and grandmother of Jesus

rows.label: Alexander Nevsky
rows.description: political and military figure of Kievan Rus' (1246–1263)

rows.label: Ambrose
rows.description: Roman theologian and Bishop of Milan (c. 340–397)

rows.label: John Bosco
rows.description: Italian Roman Catholic priest, educator, writer (1815–1888)

rows.label: Saint Barbara
rows.description: early Christian saint and martyr, from Nicomedia (273-306)

rows.label: Agatha of Sicily
rows.description: Christian saint and martyress (235–261)

rows.label: Saint Cecilia
rows.description: Roman Catholic saint, martyr and patron saint of music
rows.hook: is a martyr said to have sung in her heart to God while musicians played at her wedding

rows.label: Albertus Magnus
rows.description: German-Dominican friar and saint (c. 1200–1280)
